option_relations.rationale: The clinical presentation and histopathological examination match the characteristics of Epithelioid Hemangioma.
The description of firm, nonscaly, purple erythematous patches and plaques with irregular borders is consistent with Morpheaform Hemangioma, but the histopathological features do not fully align.
The clinical presentation and histopathological examination do not perfectly match the characteristics of Microvenular Hemangioma (MVH), but some features are similar.
The description of the lesions and histopathological features does not fully align with Tufted Angioma.
